claim_boundary: This outcome-blind qualification uses eighteen new exact task/init pairs and seven frozen same-simulator physics domains: nominal plus arm mass, joint damping, and arm sliding friction scales. Each perturbed model is shared by shadow prediction and actual execution, so a pass supports parameter-domain robustness, not simulator-model mismatch robustness. No policy, reward, done, task success, cost, or collision outcome is read. No task-utility, arbitrary-attack, real-time, hardware, actuator-authority, or physical-safety claim is authorized.
